summary: Verified Iteration 12 features: (1) Dashboard KPI card clickable links for Admin, Admin Project / Developer, Accounting, and Client roles; (2) Task detail rich-text description with inline image upload, blur save and reload persistence; (3) Backend sanitization of description_html via PATCH /api/projects/{pid}/tasks/{tid}. Previous agent's bug fix (open_tickets card linking to new group=active instead of group=open) is working — chip 'Belum selesai' shows the Belum selesai set including 'Dikerjakan' and the list count (4 for admin, 1 for developer) matches the KPI number. All backend tests in test_iter12_rich_description.py now pass (6/6) after a small sanitation fix in backend/rich_text.py (see 'rca of the issue'). Playwright UI test confirmed inline image appears mid-text, toast 'Deskripsi disimpan' fires on blur, and after full page reload the persists and the blob src loads successfully.

minor.issue: Before fix: inner text of stripped <script>/<style> tags leaked into the plain-text `description` field (e.g. 'alert(1)'). Bleach with strip=True keeps the inner text when removing the tag. Fixed in /app/backend/rich_text.py by pre-stripping <script>/<style> blocks before bleach.clean().

action_items: Previous description seed had the hard-coded SEED_PASSWORD stored as 'Maiharta2026!' in test helpers but the environment and seeder use 'Preview123!' (I updated test_iter12_rich_description.py and _helper_login.py still has the old default — only used as script default).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/rich_text.py used bleach.clean with strip=True which keeps the inner text of removed <script>/<style> tags. Already fixed by pre-stripping those blocks with a regex (DOTALL) before bleach.
frontend TaskDescription.jsx `putHtml` relies on document.execCommand('insertHTML') which is deprecated; works today across Chromium but Safari may differ. Not blocking.

RichTextDescription hydrate() uses URL.createObjectURL per blob; cleanup only runs on component unmount. If the same editor hydrates many images in a single mount lifecycle, memory grows until drawer close. Minor.
backend/tests/_helper_login.py still hard-codes password 'Maiharta2026!' — not currently used by test_iter12 but may confuse the next agent; align with SEED_PASSWORD env.

Dashboard.jsx conditional kpi link for Accounting (`acc ? '/finance' : '/tickets?group=active'`) is correct; however Accounting role gets 403 from GET /api/tickets so if the user ever navigates there via UI shortcut it will fail. Current KPI avoids /tickets for Accounting, so OK.

After successful login the SPA lands on '/' not '/dashboard' — wait for [data-testid=dashboard-kpi-0] rather than the URL. Toolbar buttons: task-desc-bold/italic/ul/ol/link/image, hidden input task-image-input. Non-manager renders data-testid=task-description (read-only).
rca of the issue: Bleach's strip=True removes disallowed tags but preserves their text content. The sanitizer wrote the cleaned HTML (safe) correctly, but the plain-text `description` was derived from that HTML and therefore inherited the inner text of <script>/<style>. Fix: pre-strip <script>...</script> and <style>...</style> blocks with a DOTALL regex *before* bleach runs, so their inner content is never surfaced in either `description_html` or `description`. Verified by TestSanitize::test_sanitize_script_and_handlers (now passing).
